clips.name: wave
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage, original left and with Wave right: her arms, her dress and the edge of the stage floor ripple in small waves that travel slowly through the picture
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Wave at its default settings.

clips.name: wave-presets
clips.alt: The dancer four times in a grid, moving in sync, each with one preset: Heat Shimmer top left with fine trembling edges, Dream top right with the whole figure swaying in long slow waves, Flag bottom left bending up and down like a banner, Funhouse Mirror bottom right pushed sideways into one broad curve
clips.caption: The four presets on the moving dancer, in sync.

clips.name: wave-height
clips.alt: The dancer with Wave while Wave Height runs from 0 to 0.06 and back: the picture starts to bend up and down in broad waves across the frame, the edge of the floor turns into hills, and it settles again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Wave Height from 0 to 0.06 and back, Sway 0.

clips.name: wave-count
clips.alt: The dancer with Wave while Wave Count runs from 1 to 16 and back: one slow bend across the frame becomes many tight ripples that make her outline tremble, and widens again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Wave Count from 1 to 16 and back, at Wave Height 0.02.

clips.name: wave-sway
clips.alt: The dancer with Wave while Sway runs from 0 to 0.06 and back: her figure is pushed left and right into a snake-like curve from head to feet, and straightens again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Sway from 0 to 0.06 and back, Wave Height 0.

clips.name: wave-sway-count
clips.alt: The dancer with Wave while Sway Count runs from 1 to 16 and back: one broad sideways bend becomes a tight zigzag through the whole figure, and widens again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Sway Count from 1 to 16 and back, at Sway 0.02.

clips.name: wave-speed
clips.alt: The dancer with Wave at three speeds, about two seconds each: at Speed 0 the waves stand still while she moves through them, at 0.5 they travel slowly, at 2 they wobble quickly; the speed is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Speed 0, 0.5 and 2, about two seconds each.

clips.name: wave-phase
clips.alt: The dancer with Wave at Speed 0 while Phase runs from 0° to 360° and back: the waves slide along by one whole wave and back again; the current angle is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Phase from 0° to 360° and back, at Speed 0.
